Human: What causes menopause to happen?

Assistant: During menopause, the normal flow of hormones that were produced by the ovaries is stopped.  Most of the time when this occurs, the ovaries continue to make the hormones Estradiol. 
Without Estradiol your body produces something different which also includes the sex hormones Progesterone (which prevents your uterus lining from growing and stops your periods) and Ovul-rogesterine (which stops ovulation).
For about 4-5 years before menopause, your body produces this high ratio in order to prepare your body for a womanopause period.  After that, your body stops this hormone production program as if it was a daily chore just like brushing one’s teeth and hair.  
The symptoms you may experience during menopause can usually be controlled by dieting or taking hormone replacements pills which change the ratio back to normal just before menopause takes place again.
Menopause is normal to experience at least once in a woman’s life time.
